purpose: Carrier attribution for the DEV-CAL-1 terminal TRANSFERABLE_HEADROOM_OCM_MISSES: the benchmark provably carries structural transferable headroom (cell B oracle-history burden reduction +97.0% [96.5, 97.4] vs RESET, PR #328 cc3af86d) that the actual OCM history cannot reach. This study grants the OCM side EXACTLY ONE interface component per arm — as data, never as a code change — and identifies which missing component (the carrier) blocks the transfer.

parent_anchors.terminal_rule_being_executed: oracle wins in cell B, OCM_CONTINUED does not reach the oracle's reduction. Benchmark viable; proceed to carrier attribution knockouts.
parent_anchors.oracle_ceiling_cell_B: +97.0% acquisition-burden reduction, bootstrap CI [96.5, 97.4], n=90 world-seed pairs, draw-invariant, shuffle null p=0.79
parent_anchors.reset_floor_cell_B: RESET arm as committed in DEVCAL1_RESULTS.json
parent_anchors.controls_validity_carried_from_devcal1: A positive control fired (+97.3%), C surface-mimicry control silent (-32.1%), D negative control silent (-24.5%); controls are RE-RUN per arm here (assay validity is per-arm, never inherited)
parent_anchors.ocm_continued_status_in_parent: OMITTED_WITH_REASON: no natural typed-operator OCM history exists for the reminted world matrix and fabricating one is forbidden by the DEV-CAL-1 purity rules; this is exactly the gap the knockouts below attribute

interface_components.REPRESENTATION: histories may store and serve typed-operator STRUCTURAL CERTIFICATES for their stored objects: the m* template (decomposition DAG modulo relabeling), the typed-operator support multiset, digest-bound, in the DEV-CAL-1 certificate format (devcal1_certificates.py emitters, unchanged)
interface_components.RETRIEVAL_KEYING: retrieval is keyed by structural certificate (same three certificate types as latent_same) instead of/by the surface signature; a reminted target retrieves history objects of its latent class
interface_components.TRANSPORT_MAP: an explicit transport map — the verified homomorphism the DEV-CAL-1 checker already accepts as certificate (c) — carries a retrieved certificate onto the reminted surface symbols
interface_components.CHARGING_MODEL: per-world history acquisition cost is amortised across the world family that shares the certificate (the DEV-CAL-1 fully-charged variant measured -14.7% in cell B at a 2-world economy; amortisation structure is an open variable)

design.world_matrix: IDENTICAL to the frozen DEV-CAL-1 matrix: exact/results/DEVCAL1_world_freeze_table.json verbatim, same worlds, same cells, same seeds, same ecology axes; DC2 arms are NEW arms on the SAME matrix (comparability by construction; the committed DEVCAL1 anchors remain the reference values)

ladder_arms_PRIMARY.KO-1_REPRESENTATION: grant REPRESENTATION only. Certificates are stored in history and visible as content; retrieval, transport and charging unchanged. If the existing pipeline cannot even incidentally use stored certificates, this arm is expected silent — that silence is a measurement, not a waste
ladder_arms_PRIMARY.KO-2_PLUS_RETRIEVAL: grant REPRESENTATION + RETRIEVAL_KEYING. A reminted target retrieves by certificate; no object transformation occurs at serve time
ladder_arms_PRIMARY.KO-3_PLUS_TRANSPORT: grant REPRESENTATION + RETRIEVAL_KEYING + TRANSPORT_MAP. The full serve path from history object to reminted surface exists
ladder_arms_PRIMARY.KO-4_PLUS_CHARGING: the full stack + CHARGING_MODEL. Identical serve path to KO-3; only the cost accounting of acquisition changes

design.leave_one_out_SECONDARY: from the full KO-4 stack, remove exactly one component (4 arms: -REPRESENTATION, -RETRIEVAL, -TRANSPORT, -CHARGING). A component whose removal collapses recovery is NECESSARY; the ladder says which are SUFFICIENT in sequence. Divergence between the two readings is recorded, not adjudicated here
design.anchors_per_world_pair: ORACLE_HISTORY, RESET, SHUFFLED_HISTORY re-run unchanged from the committed DEVCAL1 arm definitions on every world-pair (the anchors must reproduce the committed values within frozen tolerance or the run is ASSAY_DEFECT)
design.adapters_are_data: every grant is a DECLARATIVE adapter record consumed by the unchanged runner (component name, certificate digests, keying rule id, transport map id, amortisation rule id); adapters are sha256-bound and emitted in the receipts; NO runner code change is authorised by this freeze
design.controls_per_arm: cells A, C, D re-run for every arm; the DEV-CAL-1 assay-validity rule applies per-arm (A must fire, C and D must stay silent)

endpoints.primary: recovery_share in cell B per arm: (burden_RESET - burden_arm) / (burden_RESET - burden_ORACLE_HISTORY), on acquisition burden compute-matched and information-matched, all HDI-14 cost families charged (acquisition, retrieval, rejected candidates, verification, bytes/state, adaptation)
endpoints.secondary: total_burden_incl_acquisition recovery_share (the amortisation-sensitive readout); search-geometry receipts per SEARCH_GEOMETRY_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_V1 on every arm x cell (HDI-15)
endpoints.prediction_registered: the failing carrier is the interface pipeline's first missing component; if the DEV-CAL-1 attribution (representational world/operator interface) is right, KO-1 alone stays silent and KO-2 or KO-3 is the minimal recovering tier; if amortisation alone blocks transfer, KO-3 recovers on the primary but not the secondary readout

terminals.CARRIER_IDENTIFIED_TIER_k: tier k is the MINIMAL ladder arm whose cell-B recovery_share >= the frozen threshold (below), with the anchor reproduction check passing. The component granted at tier k is THE failing carrier; architecture work on exactly that component (and nothing else) becomes authorised, per #323 section 6
terminals.INTERFACE_GRANTS_INSUFFICIENT: no tier including the full stack reaches the threshold while the oracle anchor still reproduces its committed reduction. The block is not any single grantable component; the negative stands with the causal statement that the interface pipeline as a whole does not carry the oracle's transfer. Any further move is a NEW frozen study, not a re-run
terminals.AMORTISATION_DOMINATED: tiers reach the threshold on the primary readout but none on total_burden_incl_acquisition. Carrier = charging model (KO-4's component); amortisation structure becomes the authorised work item, no other component may be touched
terminals.ASSAY_DEFECT: any arm's control failure (A silent, or C/D alarmed), anchor reproduction failure, or draw-invariance failure of the primary endpoint. The arm does not bear on carriers at all; fix the assay and re-run

effect_threshold: material recovery = recovery_share >= 0.25 of the oracle's cell-B reduction with non-overlapping bootstrap CIs at the frozen seed grid AND shuffle-equal-n null non-alarm; frozen BEFORE any run
host_rules: runs on laptop billy / billy-old / LUNARC only; never Mac mini; fresh worktree; receipts sha-bound; 13-family receipt coverage rule of RECEIPT_COVERAGE_V1.json applies with explicit cannot_check markers for applicable-but-unmeasured families
checker_requirements: single-component verifier: each KO adapter record names exactly the components its arm grants; any extra capability in the record fails closed
adapter digest binding: every adapter record's sha256 is emitted in the receipts and any post-hoc adapter edit is drift
anchor reproduction: ORACLE_HISTORY/RESET/SHUFFLED_HISTORY re-runs must match the committed DEVCAL1 cell values within the frozen tolerance (bootstrap CI overlap), else ASSAY_DEFECT
fail-closed structural-certificate checker unchanged from DEV-CAL-1 (certificate type + digest per latent_same pair; CANNOT_CHECK with reason, never silence)
history purity checker unchanged (target-solution digests absent from history bytes, both directions)
cost completeness: all HDI-14 cost families charged to every arm including adapter storage/serve costs
shuffle-equal-n null on every adaptive comparison; draw-invariance control on every 1-bit endpoint; positive control must fire and negative control must stay silent PER ARM
explicitly_not_authorized_by_this_freeze: any tau change, mutation-operator retuning, threshold tuning, architecture change (#323 section 11) — this freeze AUTHORIZES at most the component named by a CARRIER_IDENTIFIED_TIER_k terminal, and only after it fires
any runner/world/certificate-emitter code change; grants are data records only
granting more than the arm's declared components (including via adapter side effects)
redefining the structural relation, the certificate types, or the world matrix after seeing DC2 outcomes
using stored target methods or semantic family labels as evidence of anything
